Docs.summary: One-line entry point for running an Activity protocol server. Each overload creates the Core host builder, registers the Activity protocol, builds, and runs (wiring OpenTelemetry, health probes, and the Foundry middleware for you).

remarks.para: Pick the overload that matches how your agent is constructed:

list.item: — host a Microsoft 365 Agents SDK by type (handlers registered in its constructor). The fastest path to a working server.
— host an application created by a factory with access to the service provider.
— host a pre-built application instance as-is.
— build the stack and register handlers inline on the application (no agent class required).
— own the request pipeline entirely; the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK is not initialized.
